en: Check Items: the 35 back-bar and retail items with cost, price, reorder point, par level, supplier and lead days. Back-bar means the products used on clients, not sold. Update a cost or a price here first.
mt: 检查项目：35 个后栏（用于服务）和零售项目，包括成本、价格、再订购点、标准水平、供应商和提前期。 Back-bar是指供客户使用的产品，而不是出售的产品。首先在此处更新成本或价格。

en: Fill in the Hygiene Log and the Steriliser Log every day. They are generic logs: check your own local rules for what you must record and keep. Redo any missed check the same day.
mt: 每天填写卫生日志和Steriliser log。它们是通用日志：检查您自己的本地规则以了解必须记录和保留的内容。当天重做任何错过的检查。

en: Keep Equipment Servicing up to date with the last and next service dates and Supplier Price Changes with every change in a cost. Check the retail price when a cost rises.
mt: 让 Equipment servicing 及时了解上次和下次服务日期的最新情况，并及时了解 供应商价格变动 费用的每次变化。当成本上升时检查零售价。

en: Use Usage per Service and Services to see the product cost of each service from the units it uses, and Laundry and Linen for the monthly linen cost.
mt: 使用 每项服务的使用情况 和服务可以查看每项服务使用的单位的产品成本，使用 Laundry and linen 可以查看每月的布草成本。
why: English/Latin words left: Laundry and linen

en: Hello, the yearly profit summary is ready: {profit_12m} in the 12 months to the month starting {month}.
mt: 您好，年度利润汇总已准备就绪：从 {month} 开始的 12 个月内为 {profit_12m}。
